1. System Overview & Core Objectives 
 Fully local AI runtime with zero cloud inference dependencies. 
 Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming architecture. 
 Autonomous tool-calling agentic middleware loop. 
 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) support. 
 Air-gapped privacy-first deployment capability. 
 Hardware-aware VRAM-safe inference execution. 
2. Developer Hardware Stack 
 CPU: Intel Core i7-13700HX (16 Cores). 
 GPU: NVIDIA RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (8GB VRAM, CUDA-enabled).

 Secondary GPU: Intel UHD Graphics. 
 RAM: 16GB System Memory. 
 Storage: 1TB NVMe SSD. 
 Operating System: Windows 11 Home Single Language. 
3. Hardware Boundary Architecture 
 Windows reserves approximately 0.8GB–1.2GB VRAM for rendering overhead. 
 Maximum stable inference budget: 6.5GB–7.0GB VRAM. 
 Crossing VRAM boundaries causes Shared Memory overflow. 
 PCIe fallback causes generation performance collapse.

 All production models must remain quantized and VRAM-safe. 4. Three-Tier Architecture

7. Autonomous Agentic Execution Flow 
1. Frontend submits structured conversation arrays. 
2. FastAPI injects tool schemas into inference payload.

3. Ollama evaluates whether tool execution is required. 
4. tool_calls payloads are intercepted server-side. 
5. DuckDuckGo scraper executes in isolated middleware. 
6. Context results are appended as role='tool'. 
7. Final augmented inference stream is emitted to client.

9. Hardened Security Architecture 
 All secrets isolated inside .env configuration. 
 Frontend forbidden from external network communication. 
 Server-side validation mandatory for every request. 
 Parameterized database queries only. 
 Rate limiting enforced using slowapi. 
 Future databases require Row-Level Security (RLS). 
 Tool execution isolated from direct client access. 10. RAG Implementation Specifications 
 Embedding Model: bge-small or all-minilm.

 Embedding Model: bge-small or all-minilm. 
 Vector Database: ChromaDB or FAISS. 
 Chunking Strategy: Recursive Character Splitting. 
 Chunk Size: 500 characters. 
 Chunk Overlap: 50 characters. 
 Supported Documents: PDF, Markdown, DOCX, TXT, CSV. 
 Embeddings generated locally through Ollama runtime. 
11. Engineering Enforcement Standards 
 All Python backends must remain asynchronous. 
 All client communication must use SSE streaming.

 No external APIs directly accessible from frontend. 
 All runtime configuration isolated via environment variables. 
 All services modularized into independent layers. 
 All future features must extend this blueprint. 
12. Living Documentation Mandate 
This documentation is considered a living engineering source-of-truth. As H.I.V.E. evolves, 
every new API schema, module structure, RAG pipeline, database entity, error state, and

streaming contract must be appended to this document to prevent architectural drift and 
technical debt.
